narrative: In the account book. A scrap in the wallet, the boots already off and set by the bench, the inkhorn open. A hand is over the belt and not writing the belt. In the account book. The same scrap, the line left without a total under it. The belt closed. The boots still by the bench.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Wrote eleven pence, and closed the belt without a total.

entities.name: eleven pence
entities.context: Shown on ledger in Eleven pence
